behaviors.name: Ride the swell
behaviors.intent: Ride the simulated sea at anchor: heave with the water under the hull, pitch along the keel and roll across it, swinging a little on the anchor cable.

behaviors.name: Sail
behaviors.intent: Stand off the island, sailing slowly west to east on the horizon.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let x = -260 + time * 1.6
  self.position = (x, water_height(x, 560) * 0.8 - 0.2, 560)
end

behaviors.name: Flicker
behaviors.intent: Flicker like a candle in the sea breeze.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.light.intensity = 2.2 + sin(time * 13 + 1.7) * 0.25 + random() * 0.35
end

behaviors.name: Wheel
behaviors.intent: Circle over the cove on the sea breeze, rising and falling, banking into the turn.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let a = time * self.speed + self.phase
  let c = (self.cx, self.h + sin(time * 0.37 + self.phase) * 2.5, self.cz)
  self.position = c + (cos(a) * self.r, 0, sin(a) * self.r * 0.75)
  let dir = 1
  if self.speed < 0 then
    dir = -1
  end
  -- heading along the circle (the model faces +Z), banking into the turn
  self.rotation = (sin(time * 0.6 + self.phase) * 4, 0 - a * 57.2958 + 90 - 90 * dir, 0 - 18 * dir)
end

behaviors.name: Flap
behaviors.intent: Flap in bursts, then glide with the wings held slightly up.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let g = max(0, sin(time * 0.45 + self.parent.phase * 3))
  self.rotation = (0, 0, self.side * (8 + sin(time * 9 + self.parent.phase) * 34 * g))
end
